content_html:
watched #Dhamaka : hmmm….when was the last time I walked out of a Movie without watching the climax? KHATARNAK and bingo its Ravi Teja again with DHAMAKA 🙏

when Trinadha Rao is directs a movie you know what to expect out of it…..just like his previous movies Cinema Chupistha Mama & Nenu Local, this is also filled with illogical story and senseless characters with loud and over the top comedy and cringe sentiment in the name of middle class sentiments, which somehow miraculously works for him 🤷🏻‍♂️ and thats exactly Dhamaka is all about!!!!

not sure why Mass Maharaja Ravi Teja has been focusing on Powerful Characters rather than sticking to his original Mass Entertaining Roles….missing his style of comedy from Dubai Seenu’s and Venky’s 😞

Director struck to his core strength of catering to the mass audience and cared a damn about so called Multiplex audience…will not be surprised if this movie works in B & C centre’s
